mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_business_data (id, process_instance_id, business_key, process_key, tenant_id, applicant_id, applicant_org_id, business_data) VALUES (#{id}, #{processInstanceId}, #{businessKey}, #{processKey}, #{tenantId}, #{applicantId}, #{applicantOrgId}, #{businessData})
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_business_data SET business_data = #{data.businessData}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
